def factor_vol_regime_reversal_ema_no_vol_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]

    # Range surprise with EMA smoothing
    range_ = high - low
    range_ratio = range_ / close
    range_ma = range_ratio.ewm(span=20, min_periods=1).mean()
    range_surprise = range_ratio / range_ma.replace(0, np.nan) - 1.0
    ret_1d = close.pct_change(1)
    base_signal = -ret_1d * np.maximum(range_surprise, 0) * 10.0

    # Volatility jump dampening
    close_prev = close.shift(1)
    tr1 = high - low
    tr2 = np.abs(high - close_prev)
    tr3 = np.abs(low - close_prev)
    true_range = np.maximum(tr1, np.maximum(tr2, tr3))
    atr = true_range.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    atr_prev = atr.shift(1)
    jump_flag = (true_range > 1.5 * atr_prev).astype(float)
    jump_intensity = jump_flag.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    scaling_jump = 1.0 - np.sqrt(jump_intensity.clip(0.0, 1.0))
    signal = base_signal * scaling_jump

    df_copy["factor_vol_regime_reversal_ema_no_vol_gate"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_vol_regime_reversal_ema_no_vol_gate"]
description: Simplified mutation removes volume regime gate to focus on core range reversal with EMA smoothing and volatility jump dampening. Removing low-volume dampening may improve IC by retaining reversal signals in low volume periods that still carry predictive content. Parent_strength_target: RankIC, RankICIR, MI from the core range reversal and jump dampening mechanism.
